basis: User inspected overlays, accepted current shape-controlled method, requested one-command steps6-9 and delegated task-aware rule selection.
annotation_policy: Use input placement masks as user-accepted approximate synthetic labels; do not claim independently verified output GT.

task_rule.matching: prediction with highest raster IoU to the single target; tie highest confidence then stable index
task_rule.validity: common pre-Judge technical audit; not Judge-based filtering
task_rule.distribution: report domain/scale/object/no-prediction distributions, no hidden rebalancing

safety: Technical verification failures pause affected dispatch with evidence; never skip them or replace failed outputs with heuristic images. Preserve existing22 completed jobs.
